invocation_requirements: Controller wrapper must bind COLLECTOR_SOURCE to the exact 20496-byte source executed; the standalone module intentionally does not define that external value.

Collector success must include actual controller rc0 and its final stdout receipt; RESULT.json alone is insufficient because a final recheck follows its creation and a later failure preserves both outputs.
review_limits: Static source and exact local original pin review only. No collector function, main, archive creation, Mac, P4 or phone operation was run by reviewer.
No assertion that the seven host phase receipts or current filesystem observations have already been collected by this candidate.
Complete bookends detect persistent changes but do not claim an atomic snapshot or the failure-time filesystem state.
review_scope: Fixed SOURCE/OUT and exact failure/plan/phone-stage identities
All source opens read-only, nofollow, single-link regular files, held directory fd and full9/path identities
Complete child-name sets, all-file byte/full9 rechecks before writes, after copies, and after RESULT
Exact seven ended host phase receipts and original capture EOF/inode/stdout/stderr links
New OUT and evidence files create-only with fsync and held-inode readback
Tar regular-only canonical relative paths and lossless XZ roundtrip
Later observation/non-atomic semantics and preserved failure state
